meta.name: docs-svg-kit
meta.description: Author SVG figures for Grida docs — diff-able, version-controlled vector diagrams embedded in doc pages instead of screenshots. Provides reusable primitives (selection chrome, size badges, anchor pins, resize cursors, click ripples), color/typography tokens, a starter template, and finished examples to crib from. Canvas user docs (docs/editor/) are the first consumer; the kit is meant to generalize to any product's docs. Use when drawing diagrams that explain UI behaviour — gestures, alignment, before/after states — that a screenshot alone can't capture. Trigger phrases: "svg diagram", "draw a figure", "visual for docs", "explain this gesture visually", "before/after diagram".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在文档中绘制可版本控制的矢量示意图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在文档中嵌入比截图更清晰的交互示意图
copy.tagline_en: Draw version-controlled vector diagrams in your docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to embed clear interactive diagrams in documentation instead of screenshots

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述，生成可嵌入文档页面的 SVG 矢量图，用于展示界面交互、手势、前后对比等截图难以表达的内容。
howto.when: 当你需要绘制解释 UI 行为的示意图（如手势、对齐、前后状态），或说出“svg diagram”、“draw a figure”、“visual for docs”等触发词时。

say.text: 画一个双击编辑文本的示意图。
say.note: 会生成包含点击波纹和手势的 SVG 图。

say.text: 画一个拖拽调整大小的前后对比图。
say.note: 会生成包含尺寸徽章和光标变化的 SVG。

say.text: 为文档画一个对齐锚点的示意图。
say.note: 会生成包含锚点引脚和参考线的 SVG。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate SVG vector diagrams for embedding in doc pages, illustrating UI interactions, gestures, before/after states, and other concepts that screenshots alone cannot capture.
howto.when_en: When you need to draw diagrams explaining UI behavior (gestures, alignment, before/after states), or use trigger phrases like "svg diagram", "draw a figure", "visual for docs".

say_en.text: Draw a diagram of double-clicking to edit text.
say_en.note: Generates an SVG with click ripples and gesture cues.

say_en.text: Draw a before/after diagram of resizing by dragging.
say_en.note: Generates an SVG with size badges and cursor changes.

say_en.text: Draw a diagram showing alignment anchors.
say_en.note: Generates an SVG with anchor pins and guide lines.
